;; D19 acceptance demonstration: representative pre-capture mover from
;; games/codex/pacman.txt. One ghost's rotated adjacent mover plus its east/
;; west seam extensions; the real game repeats this shape for four ghosts.

GOAL
Z

!1-

;; BEGIN MOVER
ROTATE_CMDS demo_move
 FOR g Rr
  ZIP j -.O
   ZIP v -.O
    ATOMIC
     !1j !1j [norotate]

     gv jg

     !1j !1v [norotate]

CMD demo_move_e
 FOR g Rr
  ZIP j -.O
   ZIP v -.O
    ATOMIC
     !1j

     v???g g???j

     !1j !1v

CMD demo_move_w
 FOR g Rr
  ZIP j -.O
   ZIP v -.O
    ATOMIC
     !1j

     g???v j???g

     !1j !1v
;; END MOVER
